**SEPARATE AND UNITE**

Pre-requisites for the analysis

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gapminder)

```

To view the data set that we will be using

```{r}
print(gapminder)
```

Separate year and century in the data set

```{r}
gapminder %>% 
  separate(col=year, into=c("Century","Year"),sep=2) %>% 
  print()
```

Example 2

```{r}
names <- c("Kelvin Mugwe","Luka Modric","Harry Kane","Christian Romero","Pervis Estupian","Conor Gallagher")
age <- c(23,37,30,26,24,24)
clubs<- c("Free Agent","Real Madrid","Bayern Munich","Tottenham Hotspur","Brighton hoveAlbion","Chelsea")
players <-data.frame(names,age,clubs)
print(players)
```

To separate the names into first name and last name

```{r}
 players <-players %>%
  separate(col=names,into=c("First_Name","Last_Name"),sep=" ") %>% 
  print()
```

Changing the data type of age into integer

```{r}
players$age <- as.integer(players$age)
glimpse(players)
```

Unite Function

```{r}
players %>% 
  unite(col=Names,First_Name,Last_Name,sep=" ") %>% 
  print()

```
